sion.why: Glory in Death only triggers on fatal damage to Sion, which never happens against a dummy that never attacks, so P is inert in this fight. Q and R are both charges whose damage ramps with hold time; R also ends the instant it collides with an enemy, so how far Sion starts from the dummy decides whether the 3-second damage ramp is reached - a real positional-assumption swing of up to 3x that still stays inside the primitive model. W's shield is ignored but its recast consumes it for target-max-health-scaled damage; E adds an armor-shred target-debuff.
